What we build

Connected systems, built to move.

The hard part of AI isn't the model—it's everything the model has to talk to. We build the secure, observable infrastructure in between.

Agentic

Agentic systems

Autonomous agents that plan, call tools and complete real work—with guardrails, evals and human handoff from day one.

MCP

MCP Gateway

One governed entry point for authentication, routing, observability and policy across every tool your agents can reach.

LLM Ops

Model Gateway

Route traffic across providers with fallbacks, caching, cost controls and audit trails—without rewriting your stack.

API Management

Full-lifecycle API platforms spanning design, gateway policies, developer portals and monetization.

How the lab works

From first sketch to production.

Walking pace: steady, deliberate and fast enough to matter. Every stage produces something real your team can use.

Scout

We map your systems, constraints and the shortest path to value. A week of questions saves a quarter of rework.

Prototype

A working build in weeks, using your real data and APIs—because a demo that can't touch production is just a slide.

Ship

Hardened, observable, documented and handed over. We stay until your team can run it without us.

Why “Walky”
Big platforms sprint and stumble. A lab walks—every step tested, every step forward.
